item.title: Musk Says Tesla Optimus May Be Rental-Only at About $30,000 Initial Cost
item.description:
Speaking at the Baron Investment Conference, Elon Musk said Tesla's Optimus humanoid robot may be offered on a rental-only basis, with initial per-unit costs around $30,000 and a potential decline to roughly $20,000. He claimed the robot could be five times as productive as a human, with Tesla planning internal deployment first and external deliveries around late 2027.

原文标题：马斯克称 Optimus 机器人或只租不卖 初期造价约 3 万美元

Why it matters：这是人形机器人商业化路径与成本结构的重要信号，但关键参数多为口头预期，缺乏可验证细节。

item.title: Anthropic Plans IPO Roadshow Next Week, Aims to List Before Thanksgiving
item.description:
Anthropic plans to launch its IPO roadshow next week, targeting a listing in the week of Nov 16 and completion before Thanksgiving. Earlier expectations pointed to a ~$1.5 trillion valuation and over $80 billion raise, but tech-stock volatility and concerns over AI capex have some investors balking at the price, potentially forcing a lower valuation.

原文标题：Anthropic 拟下周启动 IPO 路演 目标感恩节前挂牌

Why it matters：头部大模型公司冲击史上最大规模 IPO 之一，是 AI 资本周期与估值定价的关键风向标。

item.title: Diamond Foundry Produces World's First 200mm Single-Crystal Diamond Wafer
item.description:
Diamond Foundry announced it has produced the world's first 200mm (8-inch) single-crystal diamond wafer, a larger size that improves edge-area utilization and throughput, accelerating commercialization of diamond in semiconductors. Diamond's ultra-wide bandgap, high carrier mobility, high breakdown field and thermal conductivity make it attractive for power devices and chip heat spreaders.

原文标题：Diamond Foundry 造出首个 200mm 金刚石单晶

Why it matters：金刚石晶圆尺寸突破直接关系到功率半导体与芯片散热路线，值得算力硬件读者关注。

item.title: Anthropic IPO Outlook Shifts as Valuation and Listing Odds Are Cut
item.description:
A deepening AI market selloff is weighing on expectations for Anthropic's IPO, with valuation chatter cut as low as $1T and implied listing odds down 18%. Anthropic is at roughly $80B in run rate against a $100B year-end target, making revenue delivery the key variable for its listing story.

item.title: US DOJ Launches Super Intelligence Task Force
item.description:
The US Department of Justice has activated its Super Intelligence Task Force (DOJ-SITF) to coordinate civil and criminal litigation involving superintelligence technologies, balancing innovation protection with abuse prevention. The task force will set enforcement priorities and prosecution guidance, with representatives from the Antitrust Division, FBI, and NSA participating.

原文标题：美国司法部超级智能工作组投入运作

Why it matters：这是美国监管层针对前沿 AI 风险设立的首个跨部门执法协调机构，标志着 AI 治理从政策讨论进入司法执行阶段。

item.title: onsemi Scraps $2 Billion Czech Silicon Carbide Fab Expansion
item.description:
onsemi has abandoned its planned $2 billion silicon carbide (SiC) production line in Rožnov, Czech Republic, citing changed conditions in the global SiC market. The company said the Czech site remains central to its long-term manufacturing and growth strategy, with existing silicon and SiC chip production, R&D and hiring continuing. The move reflects shifting supply-demand dynamics in power semiconductors and automotive SiC.

原文标题：安森美放弃 20 亿美元捷克碳化硅晶圆厂扩产计划

item.title: AI Sell-Off Deepens as Nasdaq Falls 11% and Chip Stocks Drop 36%
item.description:
The S&P 500 sits about 6% below its October 6, 2026 record, but tech has absorbed far more damage: the Nasdaq is down 11% and US chip stocks 36%, matching the depth of the Covid crash. History shows only 16 of 56 slides reaching 6% went past 15%, while chip stocks took 18 years to regain their dot-com peak.

原文标题：AI 抛售潮：纳指跌 11%，芯片股回撤 36%

Why it matters：以历史崩盘为参照量化本轮 AI 行情回撤，为判断板块风险与修复周期提供可比较基准。

item.title: Crusoe Sells Unfinished Wyoming Data Center Project to Google
item.description:
Crusoe confirmed it has sold an unfinished data center project in southeastern Wyoming to Google, after failing to land Google as a customer for the campus originally planned to scale to 10 gigawatts. Google will invest $17 billion to develop the site, underscoring how hard it is for independent developers to deliver hyperscale projects on time and on budget.

原文标题：Crusoe 将怀俄明数据中心项目出售给 Google

Why it matters：超大规模算力基建的交付能力与资本格局变化，值得关注 AI 基础设施的读者留意。

item.title: Anthropic IPO Valuation Cut to $1.5T as Investors Balk at Price
item.description:
Anthropic's bid for the largest IPO ever is meeting resistance, with investors viewing even a $1.5 trillion valuation as too rich and some floating figures near $1 trillion — roughly half the original $2 trillion target. A tech selloff, quarterly losses and heavy AI infrastructure commitments are forcing deeper discounts, though the company still aims to list in mid-November.

原文标题：Anthropic IPO 估值预期下调 1.5 万亿美元仍遭投资者质疑

Why it matters：头部大模型公司 IPO 定价分歧，是观察 AI 资本周期与估值泡沫的关键信号。

item.title: Unitree and Star Legend Launch UNI-DOGGIE Consumer Collectible Robot Dog
item.description:
Unitree Robotics and Star Legend unveiled UNI-DOGGIE, their first consumer collectible robot dog, at the China International Import Expo, priced at 43,900 yuan with an initial order of 1,000 units from ADATA. Positioned as a cyberpunk-style art toy blending celebrity IP, collectibles and robotics, it offers 2 m/s movement, 12 joint motors and untethered auto-follow.

item.title: Unitree Factory Tour Reveals Humanoid Robot Lines Still Rely Heavily on Manual Labor
item.description:
After touring Unitree's Hangzhou factory, the author argues China's robot production lines are far from fully automated: only one or two new automated lines exist in the actuator and motor shops, while the rest rely on humans running old winding machines. The core thesis is that the robots are Chinese, but the robots that make robots will be Western.

原文标题：实地探访宇树工厂：人形机器人产线仍高度依赖人工

Why it matters：以一线工厂观察挑战“中国机器人制造已全面自动化”的普遍认知，为判断人形机器人量产能力与供应链格局提供稀缺的一手视角。

item.title: Alphabet's Wing to Invest $125M in Drone Factory Backing Walmart Expansion
item.description:
Alphabet's Wing will invest up to $125 million over two years to build and operate a next-generation delivery drone factory in Fort Worth, Texas, with potential annual output of tens of thousands of units, backing Walmart's plan to expand drone delivery to over 270 stores by 2027. The move follows rival Zipline's $1.5 billion raise and a new 300-site Walmart partnership, signaling a capacity and coverage race in U.S. drone delivery.

原文标题：Wing 投资 1.25 亿美元建无人机厂 支撑沃尔玛配送扩张

Why it matters：这是无人机配送从试点走向规模化产能与零售网络扩张的关键产业信号，值得关注 AI 与自动化物流交叉领域的读者留意。

item.title: SpaceX Weighs Boost Mobile Acquisition to Enter US Telecom Market
item.description:
SpaceX is in talks with EchoStar to acquire Boost Mobile, aiming to quickly enter the US mobile market via its subscriber base and retail network. Analysts caution that the deal would not automatically transfer Boost's MVNO agreements with AT&T and T-Mobile, and a restricted-party designation for SpaceX could trigger termination clauses, posing real obstacles.

原文标题：SpaceX 拟收购 Boost Mobile 切入电信市场

Why it matters：这是马斯克系公司向电信基础设施延伸的重要商业动向，但当前仍处谈判阶段且缺乏 AI 技术实质，对 AI 读者价值有限。

item.title: China's MIIT Proposes Unified ID Code for All Robot Categories
item.description:
China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology has released a draft regulation for public comment that would assign every robot shipped a unique product identity code under the GB/T 48541-2026 national standard. The scope expands from humanoid robots to all categories, including industrial, service and special-purpose robots, with comments open until December 5.

原文标题：工信部拟推机器人“一机一码” 全品类纳入统一标识

item.description:
OpenAI raised another $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation, placing it among the world's most valuable companies, though the round fell short of its initial $30 billion target at a $1.4 trillion valuation. Rival Anthropic has filed its S-1 to go public, while OpenAI is holding off on an IPO until it can make stronger safety claims.

item.title: OpenAI's GPT Image 2.6 Tops Image Arena with Flare and Sunburst Variants

Artificial Analysis benchmarks show both taking the top two spots on AA-Image-T2I v2.1 and AA-Image-Editing v2.1: Flare nearly doubles generation speed with slightly better quality, while Sunburst trades longer generation time for the #1 quality slot.

item.title: Planet Launches AI App for Natural-Language Search of Decade of Satellite Imagery
item.description:
Planet has launched Planet AI, an app that pairs large language models with more than a decade of global satellite imagery, letting users search locations, track surface changes and generate comparison or timelapse views in natural language. Built around a map-plus-chat interface, it grounds every AI conclusion in viewable source imagery, with early testing focused on conservation, land management and environmental compliance.

原文标题：Planet 推出 AI 应用 用自然语言检索十年卫星影像

Why it matters：这是地球观测从专业遥感工具转向自然语言公共决策工具的代表性产品落地，值得关注其可解释性设计。

item.title: libghostty-vt 1.0 Ships with Stable C ABI and Library API
item.description:
libghostty-vt, a portable C library extracted from Ghostty's terminal core, reaches 1.0 with both the library and its C ABI declared stable. The author says the C API is now a complete terminal emulator, runs in production across hundreds of free and commercial products serving millions of users, and is backed by an enforced ABI stability policy.

原文标题：libghostty-vt 1.0 发布 C ABI 与库接口正式稳定

item.title: Anthropic Proposes Four-Layer Agent Memory Framework with Dreaming Mechanism
item.description:
Anthropic published research titled 'The components of agent memory,' splitting Claude agent memory into four layers: session logs, memory notes, knowledge representations and context injection, plus a 'dreaming' mechanism that lets the model review logs, correct errors and distill rules during idle time. On the CL-Bench database QA task, memory-enabled Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 scored 0.838 and 0.833 on average, well above their no-memory baselines.

原文标题：Anthropic 提出智能体记忆四层框架与“做梦”机制

Why it matters：这是智能体长期记忆工程化的系统性拆解，附有基准数据与游戏实测，对构建持续学习型 Agent 有直接参考价值。

item.title: OpenAI Closes First $11 Billion Tranche at $1.25 Trillion Valuation
item.description:
OpenAI has received the first roughly $11 billion tranche of its new funding round, valuing the company at $1.25 trillion, with the remainder expected within weeks and the total potentially reaching $20 billion. The round, launched after OpenAI postponed its IPO, was scaled back from an initial plan of at least $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation as AI stocks sold off in public markets.

item.title: Cursor Adds Real-Time Voice Chat with Coding Agents
item.description:
Cursor launched a real-time voice chat feature that lets developers hold two-way spoken conversations with its coding agents, dictating changes and querying progress or diffs while coding continues in the background. The voice layer is powered by Grok Voice while coding still uses the user's chosen model, available across the IDE, web, and iOS, including Siri-initiated calls.

原文标题：Cursor 上线智能体实时语音通话功能

Why it matters：语音交互层接入编码智能体，是 AI 编程工具交互形态的一次具体演进，值得关注其实际可用性。

item.title: Amp Launches Spaces to Let a Lead Agent Orchestrate Parallel Agent Threads
item.description:
AI coding tool Amp released Spaces, where users describe a goal to a single lead agent that decomposes the work, spawns and coordinates multiple parallel agent threads, and surfaces progress as live cards. The feature shifts multi-agent orchestration from manual thread management to the agent itself, while letting team members request, comment and intervene in one shared chat, signaling a move from solo Q&A toward team-level task orchestration.

原文标题：Amp 推出 Spaces 让主 Agent 自主拆解并协调多线程任务

Why it matters：多 Agent 编排从手动分派转向主 Agent 自主协调，是智能体工作流形态的一次有代表性的产品演进。

item.title: ChatGPT 连接器静默串流工具调用 确认码跨应用流转
item.description:
开发者披露：同一账号启用两个指向同一 MCP 服务器的连接器时，ChatGPT 会把携带一次性确认码的后续工具调用静默改由另一个连接器发出，用户全程未被告知切换。该问题涉及智能体工具调用的会话隔离与授权边界，但披露者因漏洞赏金要求提交生物识别与身份证件而放弃上报，目前无官方回应。

Why it matters：暴露智能体多连接器场景下的工具调用路由与授权隔离缺陷，对构建 MCP 应用的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Alphabet 斥资 5.48 亿美元建仓高通 押注 AI 数据中心芯片
item.description:
Alphabet 第三季度首次买入高通约 297.7 万股，持仓市值约 5.48 亿美元，约占高通总股本 0.5%，为其投资组合第六大持仓。市场将此举解读为对高通从手机芯片向 AI 数据中心芯片转型的背书，消息披露后高通股价一度上涨约 5%。但监管文件仅反映 9 月 30 日持仓，未说明买入时间与交易方式，也未确认与高通 AI 数据中心业务存在采购或合作安排。

Why it matters：这是大厂资本层面对 AI 芯片格局的押注信号，但披露信息有限，属于产业动向而非技术节点。

item.title: 微软不再续签甲骨文 AI 算力租赁协议 重估 800 亿美元云合作
item.description:
微软已决定不再续签与甲骨文的 AI 算力租赁协议，并开始关闭部分租用资源，原因是甲骨文服务器搭载的英伟达 GPU 属于较早一代，难以匹配微软不断变化的技术规格。此举是微软重新评估超 800 亿美元外部云算力合作的一部分，内部对新兴云厂商的高成本与交付延迟已有不满。

Why it matters：头部云厂商首次公开收缩外部 AI 算力租赁，是观察算力供需与 GPU 代际更替的关键信号。
